contracts:
Extend the shared contracts for folders, app pairs, gestures, search, profiles, hidden apps, badges, the Hub and AI. Edit ONLY core/, data/ and app/CONTRACTS.md.
1. core/model/Layout.kt: HomeItem gains parentId: Long? = null (folder membership; a FOLDER item is the container, children have parentId = folder id and are not placed on the grid), packageName2: String? = null, activityName2: String? = null (second app of a PAIR), folderStyle: String? = null. Add enum GestureKind { SWIPE_UP, SWIPE_DOWN, SWIPE_LEFT_2F, SWIPE_RIGHT_2F, SWIPE_UP_2F, SWIPE_DOWN_2F, DOUBLE_TAP, PINCH_IN, PINCH_OUT, HOME_DOUBLE, FOLD, UNFOLD } and @Serializable data class GestureAction(type: String /* none, drawer, search, hub, settings, notifications, quick_settings, app, edit, lock_hint, recents_hint */, target: String? = null).
2. core/model/LauncherSettings.kt: add hiddenApps: Set<String> = emptySet(), gestures: Map<String, GestureAction> = default map (SWIPE_UP→drawer, SWIPE_DOWN→notifications, DOUBLE_TAP→none, PINCH_IN→edit, SWIPE_UP_2F→search, UNFOLD→none), searchEngine: String = "google" (google, bing, duckduckgo, kagi, brave, ecosia), searchProviders: Set<String> = {apps, contacts, settings, files, calendar, web, calculator, units}, badgeStyle: String = "count" (count, dot, off), activeProfile: String? = null, mailClientId: String? = null, aiMode: String = "template" (template, ondevice, off), folderStyle: String = "grid" (grid, list, big), notificationPreview: Boolean = true. Add @Serializable data class Profile(id: String, name: String, settingsJson: String, hiddenApps: Set<String>, startMinute: Int? = null, endMinute: Int? = null, days: Set<Int> = emptySet(), onDnd: Boolean = false).
3. core/repo: BadgeRepository { val counts: Flow<Map<String, Int>> /* packageName → unread count */; fun notificationsFor(packageName: String): Flow<List<NotificationSummary>> } with data class NotificationSummary(key: String, packageName: String, title: String, text: String, postTime: Long, contentIntent: android.app.PendingIntent?). ProfileRepository { val profiles: Flow<List<Profile>>; suspend fun save(profile: Profile); suspend fun delete(id: String); suspend fun activate(id: String?) /* applies settingsJson + hiddenApps via SettingsRepository and sets activeProfile */ ; suspend fun captureCurrent(name: String): Profile }. HubRepository { fun todayEvents(): Flow<List<HubEvent>>; fun eventsBetween(startMillis: Long, endMillis: Long): Flow<List<HubEvent>>; fun missedCalls(): Flow<List<HubCall>>; fun contacts(): Flow<List<HubContact>>; fun favorites(): Flow<List<HubContact>>; fun tasks(): Flow<List<HubTask>>; suspend fun setTaskDone(id: Long, done: Boolean); suspend fun addTask(title: String, dueMillis: Long?) } with data classes HubEvent(id, title, begin, end, allDay, location, color: Int), HubCall(id, number, name, time), HubContact(id, name, phone, email, photoUri: String?, starred: Boolean, lookupKey), HubTask(id, title, dueMillis, done). MailRepository { val state: Flow<MailState>; suspend fun connect(activity: android.app.Activity); suspend fun disconnect(); suspend fun refresh() } with sealed MailState { NotConfigured, Disconnected, Connecting, Connected(messages: List<MailMessage>, unread: Int), Error(message) } and MailMessage(id, from, subject, snippet, date: Long, unread). AiProvider { val name: String; suspend fun complete(prompt: String, context: String): String; suspend fun available(): Boolean } and AiCommandRouter { suspend fun handle(text: String): AiReply } with AiReply(text: String, appliedSettings: Boolean).
4. core/AppGraph.kt: add val badges: BadgeRepository; val profiles: ProfileRepository; val hub: HubRepository; val mail: MailRepository; val ai: AiCommandRouter. Keep AppGraphImpl compiling with placeholder implementations in data/ (empty flows, NotConfigured mail, template AI echo) that feature agents replace.
5. data/: Room version 3 with Migration(2,3) adding parentId, packageName2, activityName2, folderStyle; DAO methods childrenOf(parentId) and LayoutRepository gains fun children(folderId: Long): Flow<List<HomeItem>>, suspend fun createFolder(pageId: Long, col: Int, row: Int, title: String, itemIds: List<Long>): Long, suspend fun createPair(pageId: Long, col: Int, row: Int, a: AppInfo, b: AppInfo): Long, suspend fun removeFromFolder(itemId: Long, toPageId: Long, col: Int, row: Int). AppsRepositoryImpl filters settings.hiddenApps out of `apps` (keep a separate `allApps` flow).
6. Update app/CONTRACTS.md with everything above and this phase's ownership: gestures/ (gestures agent, may also edit settings/GesturesPage.kt), search/ (search agent, may add settings/SearchSettingsPage.kt), items/ (folders + pairs agent), home/ (home agent), profiles/ (profiles agent, may edit settings/ProfilesPage.kt), notifications/ (badges agent, may edit builtins/FoldOsNotificationListener.kt), hub/ (hub-core agent), mail/ and ai/ (hub-mail-ai agent, may edit settings/AiPage.kt).
Return the exact new signatures.

features.prompt: You own package com.foldos.launcher.gestures and may edit settings/GesturesPage.kt. Build gesture detection for the home screen: '@Composable fun Modifier.homeGestures(enabled: Boolean, settings: LauncherSettings, onAction: (GestureAction) -> Unit): Modifier' using pointerInput: one-finger vertical swipes (up/down, threshold 80dp, velocity-aware), two-finger swipes (track pointer count), double tap, pinch in/out (transform gesture scale < 0.85 / > 1.15); the horizontal pager keeps one-finger horizontal swipes, so do not consume those. Hinge gestures: 'class HingeGestureDetector' that observes FoldState transitions (cover→inner = UNFOLD, inner→cover = FOLD) and emits the configured action once per transition. 'object GestureActions { fun perform(context: Context, action: GestureAction, host: GestureHost) }' where GestureHost is an interface with openDrawer(), openSearch(), openHub(), openSettings(), enterEditMode(), launch(packageName, activityName); notifications/quick settings use StatusBarManager via reflection (expandNotificationsPanel / expandSettingsPanel) wrapped in runCatching with a toast fallback. Settings › Gestures page: one row per GestureKind with a dropdown of action types and, for 'app', an app picker dialog listing apps from LocalAppGraph; writes settings.gestures.

You own package com.foldos.launcher.search and may add settings/SearchSettingsPage.kt. Build universal search per PLAN.md section 4: '@Composable fun UniversalSearch(visible: Boolean, screen: ScreenKind, settings: LauncherSettings, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onLaunch: (AppInfo) -> Unit, onOpenSettingsRoute: (String) -> Unit)' as a top-anchored sheet with a text field focused on open, result sections and keyboard actions. Providers (each toggleable via settings.searchProviders): apps (label + package, fuzzy prefix match), app shortcuts (LauncherApps.getShortcuts with ShortcutQuery, FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC|MANIFEST|PINNED, launched via startShortcut), contacts (ContactsContract with READ_CONTACTS via LocalPermissionRequester; call/message actions), settings (an index of every SettingsRowInfo title/subtitle → route, built from the settings package's page objects), files (MediaStore.Files recent by name, ACTION_VIEW), calendar (CalendarContract.Instances next 30 days), calculator (a small expression evaluator supporting + - * / % ^ parentheses), units (length, weight, temperature, currency with static sample rates), web (search engine from settings.searchEngine with URL templates; !bang support: !g !ddg !yt !w !maps !amazon), visual search (opens Google Lens intent com.google.ar.lens if installed else a web image search). Usage ranking: a Preferences DataStore counting picks per result key, recency-weighted. 'object SearchIndex' with a suspend fun query(text): List<SearchResult> (sealed) and a composable result row per type. Settings › Search page: engine dropdown, provider toggles, 'Clear search history'. Expose '@Composable fun SearchBar(onClick, settings, modifier)' for the home.

You own package com.foldos.launcher.items. Build folders and app pairs: '@Composable fun FolderIcon(folder: HomeItem, children: List<HomeItem>, apps: Map<String, AppInfo>, sizeDp: Int, style: String, modifier)' (grid preview of up to 4 child icons; 'big' style shows a 2x2 live mini-grid; list style shows a stacked look), '@Composable fun FolderSheet(folder: HomeItem, children: List<HomeItem>, apps: Map<String, AppInfo>, onLaunch: (AppInfo) -> Unit, onRename: (String) -> Unit, onRemove: (HomeItem) -> Unit, onDismiss: () -> Unit)' (pop-up card near the icon with title editing, grid/list per settings.folderStyle, drag-out removal via a Remove chip); '@Composable fun PairIcon(pair: HomeItem, a: AppInfo?, b: AppInfo?, sizeDp: Int, modifier)' split diagonal icon; 'object AppPairs { fun launch(context: Context, a: AppInfo, b: AppInfo) }' launching a normally, then b with Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_ADJACENT | NEW_TASK | MULTIPLE_TASK after a 350 ms delay; '@Composable fun PairEditorSheet(apps: List<AppInfo>, onCreate: (AppInfo, AppInfo) -> Unit, onDismiss)' picking two apps. Also '@Composable fun ItemContextMenu(item: HomeItem, actions: List<ContextAction>, onDismiss)' (Edit, Remove, App info, Uninstall, Hide, Add to pair, Icon override) used by home on long-press when not in edit mode; App info/Uninstall via standard intents.

You own package com.foldos.launcher.home (existing files; keep public signatures used by LauncherRoot.kt, adding parameters with defaults). Render ItemKind.FOLDER via com.foldos.launcher.items.FolderIcon and open items.FolderSheet on tap; render ItemKind.PAIR via items.PairIcon and launch with items.AppPairs.launch; show notification badges on app icons from LocalAppGraph.current.badges.counts according to settings.badgeStyle (count pill / dot / none) and settings.feature(FEATURE_BADGES); long-press on an item (outside edit mode) opens items.ItemContextMenu, and when settings.notificationPreview is on and the app has notifications, show a notification preview popup (list of NotificationSummary with tap → contentIntent.send()) above the context menu; apply settings.hiddenApps to the drawer/home app lists via the already-filtered apps flow; smart rules for stacks: a stack whose builtin ids include a time-tagged rule (HomeItem.title like 'rule:09:00-17:00') auto-selects the matching index. Keep everything else intact. Read items/ and notifications/ on disk for exact signatures before calling them.

You own package com.foldos.launcher.profiles and may edit settings/ProfilesPage.kt. Implement ProfileRepository as class FoldOsProfileRepository(context, settings: SettingsRepository, appScope) persisting profiles as JSON in a Preferences DataStore 'foldos_profiles'; activate() decodes settingsJson into LauncherSettings, keeps wizardDone/preset/activeProfile fields consistent, writes hiddenApps and activeProfile; captureCurrent() snapshots the current settings. Scheduling: 'class ProfileScheduler(context)' using AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle for the next start/end boundary of any profile with a time rule, a BroadcastReceiver ProfileAlarmReceiver (declare it in the manifest via your integration notes; exported false) that activates the matching profile and reschedules; BOOT_COMPLETED receiver to reschedule (RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED permission); DND rule via NotificationManager.getCurrentInterruptionFilter polled when the app resumes plus ACTION_INTERRUPTION_FILTER_CHANGED receiver. UI: '@Composable fun ProfileSwitcherSheet(onDismiss)' (list with active tick, 'Save current as…', per-profile edit opening ProfileEditor with name, time range pickers, days, DND toggle, hidden apps multi-select from LocalAppGraph.apps); Settings › Profiles page lists profiles and the switcher. Default profiles seeded once: Work (09:00–17:00 Mon–Fri), Home, Night (22:00–06:00, hides social apps if present).

You own package com.foldos.launcher.notifications and may edit builtins/FoldOsNotificationListener.kt. Implement BadgeRepository as class FoldOsBadgeRepository: FoldOsNotificationListener publishes active notifications (onListenerConnected/onNotificationPosted/Removed, grouped summaries excluded, ongoing/media notifications excluded) into a process-wide MutableStateFlow<List<StatusBarNotification>> that the repository maps to counts per package and NotificationSummary lists (title/text from extras EXTRA_TITLE/EXTRA_TEXT, contentIntent). Provide 'fun isNotificationAccessGranted(context): Boolean' and '@Composable fun NotificationAccessCard(onOpenSettings)' prompting for access. Also a 'Quiet notification drawer' (PLAN.md 4.1): a settings-driven list of packages whose notifications are shown only inside a '@Composable fun QuietDrawerSheet(onDismiss)' (list of their notifications) instead of as badges; expose rows for Settings › Features (toggle + package multi-select) as composables the Integrate agent can place.

You own package com.foldos.launcher.hub. Implement HubRepository as class FoldOsHubRepository(context) over CalendarContract.Instances (events), CallLog.Calls (missed calls, READ_CALL_LOG), ContactsContract (contacts, favorites with STARRED, photos), and a local tasks DataStore 'foldos_tasks'; every query runs on Dispatchers.IO and returns empty when the permission is missing (expose 'fun missingPermissions(): List<String>'). Build the Hub page per PLAN.md 2.5 and the mock-up (functions todayPage, calPage, peoplePage, tabBar): '@Composable fun HubPage(screen: ScreenKind, settings: LauncherSettings, modifier)' with a tab bar (bottom or top per settings.hubBar; only settings.hubTabs shown; Today always) and tabs: Today (greeting by hour, weather line from builtins' FakeWeatherProvider, briefing sentence built from today's data, next event card with Join button when the location/description holds a URL, tasks card with add/complete, schedule, missed calls 'Reach out' row with call/message actions, permission cards for calendar/call log/contacts when missing), Calendar (week strip, day timeline with a now line and overlapping-event layout, month grid on the inner screen's left pane, 'New event' FAB → CalendarContract insert intent), Contacts (favorites row, search, A–Z list with section headers and alphabet scrubber, call/message buttons; inner screen: list + contact card with call/message/video/email actions and recent calls). Mail and AI tabs render composables from the mail/ and ai/ packages: call com.foldos.launcher.mail.MailTab(screen, settings) and com.foldos.launcher.ai.AiTab(screen, settings) (another agent writes them with exactly these signatures).

You own packages com.foldos.launcher.mail and com.foldos.launcher.ai and may edit settings/AiPage.kt and add settings/MailSettingsPage.kt. MAIL: implement MailRepository as class GmailRepository(context, settings): (a) always-available unread counts from the Gmail content provider com.google.android.gm (content://com.google.android.gm/<account>/labels, permission com.google.android.gm.permission.READ_CONTENT_PROVIDER — include it in your integration notes) for accounts from AccountManager (GET_ACCOUNTS not needed on API 26+ for own-visible accounts; use AccountManager.getAccountsByType('com.google') guarded with runCatching); (b) the Gmail API when settings.mailClientId is set: add net.openid:appauth:0.11.1 to the version catalog and build file (you may edit gradle/libs.versions.toml and app/build.gradle.kts for this one dependency, plus the manifest placeholder appAuthRedirectScheme = 'com.foldos.launcher'), authorize with scopes gmail.readonly, fetch messages.list(maxResults 25, q 'in:inbox') and messages.get(format=metadata, headers From/Subject/Date) via HttpsURLConnection + org.json, store tokens in EncryptedSharedPreferences if androidx.security:security-crypto:1.1.0-alpha06 resolves (else plain prefs with a comment). '@Composable fun MailTab(screen: ScreenKind, settings: LauncherSettings)': NotConfigured → explanation card (what a Google Cloud OAuth client is, where to paste the client id in Settings › Mail) plus Gmail unread counts per label and 'Open Gmail'/'Compose' intents; Connected → inbox list (cover) and list + reading pane (inner) per the mock-up mailPage, with 'Reply in Gmail' deep link; Settings › Mail page: client id text field, Connect/Disconnect, refresh. AI: 'class TemplateAiProvider' (no network) that answers from local context (today's events, tasks, unread counts, settings) with sentence templates; 'class AiCoreProvider' using com.google.ai.edge.aicore:aicore:0.0.1-exp01 ONLY if you are confident the artifact exists on google() — otherwise leave a documented stub that reports available() = false; 'class FoldOsAiCommandRouter' that parses natural-language launcher commands with regexes (make my <cover|inner> screen a <dashboard|grid|list|panels>; switch to <dark|light> mode; use the <ocean|forest|...> colors; hide <app>; set <theme> theme; open <app> when I unfold) into SettingsRepository updates, else falls back to the provider; '@Composable fun AiTab(screen: ScreenKind, settings: LauncherSettings)': ask bar, conversation list, suggested actions (navigate to next event location, reply hints), 'Try asking' chips, on-device badge; Settings › AI page: aiMode select (template/ondevice/off) and an 'AI usage log' list (what ran, on what data) kept in DataStore.

integrate: Wire Phase 4+5 into the app. You may edit any file. (1) AppGraphImpl: replace placeholders with FoldOsBadgeRepository, FoldOsProfileRepository, FoldOsHubRepository, GmailRepository, FoldOsAiCommandRouter (TemplateAiProvider default; AiCoreProvider when aiMode == ondevice and available). (2) LauncherRoot/LauncherViewModel: apply homeGestures on the home content with a GestureHost implementation; HingeGestureDetector on FoldState; replace the HomeSearchBar stub with search.SearchBar and mount UniversalSearch; mount HubPage as the hub pager page; folder creation when an app is dropped onto another app in edit mode (createFolder) and PairEditorSheet from the item context menu; ProfileSwitcherSheet reachable from the edit bar and Settings; QuietDrawerSheet from the dock's notification add-on. (3) Settings: register routes for Gestures, Search, Profiles, Mail, AI pages; Features page gets badge style select, notification preview toggle, quiet drawer rows; Home page gets folder style select. (4) Manifest: READ_CONTACTS, READ_CALL_LOG, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, com.google.android.gm.permission.READ_CONTENT_PROVIDER, INTERNET; receivers ProfileAlarmReceiver and the boot receiver; appAuthRedirectScheme manifestPlaceholder in app/build.gradle.kts if AppAuth was added; queries for com.google.android.gm and Lens. (5) README: Phase 4+5 features, permissions, how to connect Gmail (OAuth client steps). (6) CONTRACTS.md ownership update. Read every call site against the real declarations and fix mismatches.
